events.description: The weight matrix and input vector are rendered on screen, with matrix elements color-coded (blue for positive, red for negative).
events.clip_query: A color-coded decimal matrix and a column vector appear on screen.

events.description: Yellow surrounding rectangles highlight the first row of the matrix and the elements of the input vector sequentially.
events.clip_query: Yellow boxes highlight a row of the matrix and the vector elements step-by-step.

events.description: The first entry of the result vector dynamically updates its decimal value as the row-vector multiplication is computed.
events.clip_query: The first element of the output vector dynamically changes its numerical value.

events.description: The animation loops through subsequent rows, highlighting them and updating the corresponding result vector elements before fading out the active highlights.
events.clip_query: The matrix-vector multiplication animation repeats for the remaining rows of the matrix.
